title: Research: gate-operand export parity — dest-free always agrees; dest-in can diverge (answers #3004 OQ2; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6 answering [#3004](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3004) OQ2 in the [#2977](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2977) supplier-boundary cascade: gate operands at the selected PR589 checker/exporter boundary (scatter schemas already audited).

At that boundary, destination-free gate source lists always make accumulate-XOR and sequential ADD agree (exhaustive **4686** dest-free agreements on `n=6`, `len(srcs)≤4`; algebraic for all sizes when `d ∉ srcs`). Destination-in-sources lists can diverge under export-without-check: named witnesses `self_even` / `dest_with_src`; the checker rejects them and the exporter does not. Selected-word census: **5472** distinct gates (finding is the export-without-check gap, not a selected-word defect); four checker rejects; exporter +1 record on `self_even`.

Not a scatter rename: scatter agreement is “all positive multiplicities odd”; gate agreement is “destination absent from sources” (with dest-in sometimes agreeing, e.g. `self_once`). Checker rejects more than disagreeing cases (`dup_src`, `self_once` agree but still `bad operands`). Exp is a sequential-ADD model of the exporter boundary.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. No production/schema adoption.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/gate-operand-export-parity/`
- Tip: `0581402f978addb2eda5306fd124001486c76b08`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **changed** — gate-operand Sym/Exp lemma beyond scatter-only #3004/#2977 successors

Closest priors: [#3004](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3004) / [#2977](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2977) (scatter parity; leave alone; OQ2 answered), `scatter-export-parity-audit` / `scatter-parity-contract-audit` (soft-overlap verify ≈0.09–0.14). Clear of stock-leaf / flag-0 / C5 / side-correction leave-alones.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/gate-operand-export-parity/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/gate-operand-export-parity/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/gate-operand-export-parity/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/gate-operand-export-parity/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gate-operand-export-parity
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_GATE_OPERAND_EXPORT_PARITY dest_free_agree=4686 dest_in_disagree_witnesses=2 selected_distinct_gates=5472 checker_rejects=4 no_new_kappa
PASS_GATE_OPERAND_INDEPENDENT dest_free_agree=4686 dest_in_disagree>0 witnesses=self_even,dest_with_src
PASS_GATE_OPERAND_PACKAGE_TESTS
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/gate-operand-export-parity outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Credit

Credit #3004, #2977, #2992 / #3273 / #3346 scatter successors, and the retained PR589 checker/exporter lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Does a simple-support (or other) guard on gate operands reject all dest-in-sources divergent cases without rejecting agreeing dest-free lists?
2. Are the four selected-word checker rejects exhaustive for dest-in-sources divergence on the pinned word?
